fixes.replace: This is a good guide to help engage your adult in the conversation. The more powerful the state the more you will need to make use of these.
fixes.with: A good guide leaves your adult more present. The more powerful the state the stronger the boundaries you will need.
fixes.note: restores his test for any guide (it leaves your adult more present) and that powerful states need stronger boundaries; nothing points back at the list of questions

fixes.replace: you can still take away choice
fixes.with: you can still take away the subject’s choice
fixes.note: says whose choice: you use the language, the subject loses the choice

fixes.with: you notice etc etc, so either way counts as success
fixes.note: restores why the phrase binds: noticing or not, it counts as success

fixes.replace: Test: Are you getting the response you want out of this already?
fixes.with: Test: For a simple, chosen target, are you getting the response you want out of the suggestion already?
fixes.note: says what is tested (the suggestion) and when (a simple, chosen target)

fixes.replace: whatever form of signal makes sense to you (feelings, rhythms, movements, words, spatial, simple knowing
fixes.with: whatever form of signal shows up (feelings, rhythms, movements, words, spatial sense, simple knowing
fixes.note: the signal comes in whatever form it takes, lack of signal included, instead of one you pick; 'spatial' gets its noun

fixes.with: You can borrow qualities such as warmth or steadiness,
fixes.note: gives his examples of the qualities

fixes.replace: When you're writing this, think about
fixes.with: When you're writing the script, decide
fixes.note: an instruction to settle on the verb, quality, refrain and transition, not just think about them; names the script

fixes.replace: Deciding to do it. How will you coax yourself to do this? Make it spacious? Make it warm and held? Something else?
fixes.with: Deciding to do it: how will you coax yourself to do this? Make it spacious? Make it warm and held? Firmer, to stay with a feeling? Something else?
fixes.note: the fragment now leads into its question, as 'Preview what you are going to do:' does; restores the firmer option

fixes.replace: read the script if you can
fixes.with: read the script beforehand if you can

fixes.note: says it is the first few sessions where you make sure you can change state

fixes.replace: Utilize. Use what you have to go to the next place
fixes.with: Utilize: use what you have (a thought, sound, movement, or objection) to go to the next place
fixes.note: 'Utilize' is explained by what follows it, with his examples

fixes.replace: no change is not a positive change
fixes.with: no change is not a secret success
fixes.note: restores the warning not to take no change for hidden success

fixes.replace: read this slowly to yourself on your recorder
fixes.with: read this slowly into your recorder
fixes.note: recording no longer mixed up with reading to yourself
the two-hand practice comes earlier, not later

fixes.replace: something that you are doing that holds your interest
fixes.note: drops the stacked 'that you are doing'

fixes.replace: Let your attention come back to your chosen anchor.
fixes.with: 5. Let your attention come back to your chosen anchor.
fixes.note: the count starts at 5, as 'Count 5 to 1' just before says
